prototype.headline: Clockify standard integrations use static API Keys (X-Api-Key) rather than 3-legged OAuth 2.0; immediate self-serve key generation.

production.handsOnTime: 1-2 days for CAKE.com marketplace manifest preparation

production.headline: No public 3-legged OAuth 2.0 authorization server is offered for standard REST API integrations. Public add-ons must use the CAKE.com Developer Portal.

verdict.confidence: high on API Key authentication; doc-confirmed absence of public OAuth2 authorize endpoints
verdict.summary: Clockify does not offer a standard public 3-legged OAuth 2.0 server for third-party developer integrations. Instead, developers authenticate API calls using a static API key (X-Api-Key) generated in Profile Settings. For multi-tenant UI add-ons, Clockify relies on the CAKE.com Developer Marketplace. In Composio, configure custom authentication using your Clockify API Key.

stages.name: Generate Clockify API Key in Profile Settings

steps.text: Log in to your Clockify account at https://app.clockify.me/.
Click on your profile avatar in the upper right (or bottom left) and select 'Profile settings'.
Scroll to the 'API' section at the bottom of the page and click 'Generate'.
Copy the generated API key and securely store it.
Navigate to Workspace Settings in Clockify to retrieve your Workspace ID, or use the /v1/workspaces endpoint with your API key.
In Composio Dashboard navigate to Auth Configs > Create Auth Config > Clockify.
Provide your Clockify API Key and Workspace ID into the configuration dialog, then click Save.
The agent executes a test call to /v1/user to confirm valid credentials and workspace connectivity.

claims.text: Clockify's public REST API authenticates requests using static API keys passed via the X-Api-Key HTTP header, rather than standard 3-legged OAuth 2.0.
API keys are generated self-serve by users under Clockify Profile Settings > API section.
Clockify API operations require specifying a target Workspace ID, accessible via the /v1/workspaces endpoint or workspace URL.
Clockify is in Composio's bring-your-own catalog where developers provide custom credentials to connect toolkits.
No RFC 8414 OAuth authorization server or OpenID discovery endpoint is advertised on clockify.me, confirming lack of standard public OAuth2 discovery.

Confirmed Clockify is classified as bring-your-own in Composio catalog

nextAction: Generate your Clockify API key at https://app.clockify.me/user/settings and configure it in Composio.
composioTail: In the Composio dashboard go to Auth Configs, click Create Auth Config, select the toolkit and choose OAuth2.
Copy the redirect URI shown in the Composio dashboard and register it in the provider's app settings.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the provider app overview into the Composio auth config, and click Create.
Copy the resulting auth config ID (looks like ac_xxxx). Keep secrets out of source control.
Pass the auth config ID to your session: authConfigs: { [toolkit]: 'ac_xxxx' }. Toolkits not listed keep using Composio managed auth.
